sentences.en: What a blessing it is that they did not come.
sentences.zh: 他们没有来真是件幸运的事。

sentences.en: Blessed is the one who expects nothing, never being disillusioned.
sentences.zh: 不抱任何期待的人是有福的，永远不会失望。

sentences.en: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
sentences.zh: 温柔的人有福了，因为他们必承受地土。

senses.zh: 为...祝福，赐福，祈佑，称颂上帝，使神圣，赋予
